# Local Rekor verification fixtures

These tag objects were generated locally for the EA-306 offline verifier-path tests. They use a fictional self-signed code-signing certificate and isolated one-entry Rekor log; they are not gitsign-produced signatures and do not establish Sigstore production-root trust. The two valid tags share the test certificate but carry distinct artifacts, CMS signatures, and Rekor entries. Both exercise CMS extraction, Bundle construction, successful SET, inclusion, checkpoint, certificate-chain, artifact and signature verification against a test-only root. Tests mutate the extracted entry's integrated time, SET, inclusion proof, substitute the second valid tag's entry, and replace the trusted root's Rekor key to verify fail-closed results.
